title: OCR popup configuration and focus persistence
scope: SIG4A OCR quick popup and dashboard Settings page
goal: Let users configure whether the OCR popup stays visible above other windows after clicking outside it; default to staying visible.

acceptance.case: Config default and round-trip save preserve ocr_popup_always_on_top without changing unknown keys
acceptance.evidence: Locked cu-core library tests 3/3 including strict default and disabled policy. Combined with WebView2 save preserving unknown sibling keys: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45938986325/job/140308662466

acceptance.case: Settings page exposes OCR Popup section and persists the toggle
acceptance.evidence: Exact Windows WebView2 dashboard test 1/1 plus standard Windows build/API/dashboard smoke: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45938986325/job/140308662466 and https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45938859561/job/140308266475

acceptance.case: Quick OCR popup remains visible when focus moves to another window with default enabled; explicit Escape/Close still exits
acceptance.evidence: Ordinary Windows release: physical hotkey/crop, clipboard, external activation without focus steal, overlapping HWND remains exposed, warm Escape restores original result, explicit Escape closes, disabled preference persists after restart and restores ordinary z-order: https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45938986325/job/140308662799

advisor.evidence: Independent GPT-6.2 Astra approved the exact product tree 8b5efae52f05ecc7b6c82eab1eff3fa151a285bd; its native and automated Windows conditions subsequently passed.

gate.rule: Do not mark passed until automated tests, independent Advisor review, and native Windows verification pass.

limitations: Tested on hosted Windows Server 2025, not on the user's device.
The native interaction proof uses a deterministic loopback double with PNG crop validation; it does not measure model accuracy.
